chunks: Zurārah asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about fasting continuously throughout the year, and he said:

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الدَّهْرِ: the whole span of time, here meaning the entire year continuously
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator asking the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.مَكْرُوهًا: disliked; religiously discouraged though not forbidden

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting continuously throughout the whole year in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that fasting for the entire year continuously is regarded as disliked. It conveys a legal ruling in the context of worship, indicating that perpetual fasting is not the preferred practice in Shia fiqh.
